The '''2018 [[Elite One]]''' was the 58th season of the [[Cameroon]] top-tier [[association football|football]] league. The season began on 11 February and ended on 29 July 2018.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.crtv.cm/2018/02/2018-elite-one-championship-limbe-hosts-opening-match-season/|title = 2018 Elite One Championship : Limbe hosts the opening match|date = 9 February 2018}}</ref><ref>[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesk/kam2018.html Cameroon 2018], RSSSF.com</ref>
